title: Stable chart hue independent of delta movement
summary: Chart colors now represent entity identity (neutral gray) rather than movement direction. Direction is conveyed exclusively through the delta chip (arrow + figure + tone per #858), achieving stable visualization across date range changes.

apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/envelope-map.description: Changed buildLiveKpiSnapshot and buildSupplementaryChartSnapshot to return trend='neutral' (stable chart hue). Extracted rawTrend from computeDelta to preserve movement direction for signal/copy (not chart color). Signal now uses rawTrend (movement direction) not tone (goal-aware goodness) to match metricSignal function signature.

apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/mock-data.ts.description: Changed gmvTiktokSnapshot trend from 'positive' to 'neutral' per ADR-060 § 5 (stable identity hue).

packages/ui/src/__tests__/chart.test.tsx.description: Added 4 new tests verifying chart hue stability: same hue regardless of delta direction, unchanged across date ranges, no success/destructive colors on ordinary movement, delta chip conveys direction. Tests assert on CHART_SERIES_COLORS.neutral, not rendered pixels (per jsdom limitation).

apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/__tests__/en.description: Updated 11 tests from tone-based expectations to neutral trend expectations. Tests now verify: (1) trend is always 'neutral' for chart stability, (2) signal still reflects rawTrend (movement direction) for UI copy, (3) goal-aware tone is resolved but used for signal, not chart color.

apps/demo/src/__tests__/analytics-dashbo.description: Updated delta class expectation from 'analytics-delta--positive' to 'analytics-delta--neutral' (reflects chart trend, now always neutral).

acceptanceCriteria.1_metric_renders_same_hue_for_positive_a: ✅ PASS — Trend parameter is 'neutral' regardless of delta sign; CHART_SERIES_COLORS.neutral is stable.
acceptanceCriteria.2_date_range_change_preserves_metric_hue: ✅ PASS — Trend is 'neutral' for all ranges (7d/30d/90d); no repainting on range switch.
acceptanceCriteria.3_no_success_destructive_colors_on_trend: ✅ PASS — All trend metrics use neutral; success/destructive reserved for bounded-ratio breaches (#864, out-of-scope).
acceptanceCriteria.4_delta_chip_conveys_direction: ✅ PASS — Arrow glyph (▲/▼) in delta string; sr-only text includes arrow; tone used by signal for semantic copy (not chart color).
acceptanceCriteria.5_dark_mode_validation: ✅ LIGHT MODE PASS — Contrast: neutral 4.83:1, success 4.51:1, destructive 5.24:1, warning 4.63:1 (all WCAG AA). Dark mode: no tokens defined per ADR-054 (light-only); future dark work must validate selected steps against dark surface.
acceptanceCriteria.6_palette_validator_passes: ✅ PASS — Light mode: lightness band, chroma floor, CVD separation (ΔE=16.2), normal-vision floor (all pairs ΔE>15), contrast all PASS. Dark mode: out of scope (apps/demo is light-only).
acceptanceCriteria.7_tests_assert_on_real_dom: ✅ PASS — Tests assert on CSS variable strings (CHART_SERIES_COLORS), class names (analytics-delta--neutral), sr-only text presence, and snapshot trend field. No jsdom geometry assertions (getBoundingClientRect returns all-zero).

mutations.test: Changed trend='neutral' to trend=tone in buildLiveKpiSnapshot to verify tests catch regression
mutations.result: ✅ 6 tests FAILED as expected (trend assertions, delta class expectation), confirming guards are active.
mutations.restored: Reverted to trend='neutral' and all 946 demo + 120 ui tests PASS

testResults.pre_change_baseline: 946 demo tests, 116 ui tests (baseline stated in requirements; 120 ui likely includes new tests added in prior slices)

dark_mode.status: OUT_OF_SCOPE — apps/demo is light-only per ADR-054
dark_mode.note: Future dark mode work must select steps from same ramps, validate against dark surface (#1a1a1a–#262626), not invert light values

authority: docs/adr/060-chart-form-follows-kpi-measurement-type.md § 5: 'Trend marks wear a stable hue tied to the metric. Identity must not flicker between periods or ranges. Direction is carried by the delta chip, which pairs tone with an arrow and a number, so status never travels by colour alone.'
